'''Arcade Omicron''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]], situated in the city of [[Lumchugger's Hub]]. The entrance was a steeped archway topped with a flashing [[holosign]], and the establishment was often packed with the tired workers of [[Galentro Heavy Works]], who worked long hours in the planet's factories. The layout included a long hallway that was lined with several side rooms. A scaffolding stage was situated against one wall, set-up for local bands to provide music for the patrons. One such band that played in the Arcade Omicron was the ''[[Screaming Jawas]]''. In the center of the main hallway was a [[holozoetroscope]], one of the the only devices that existed outside of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The side rooms were situated with [[scenic replicator]]s which could transform the small rooms into a variety of different planetary locations.<ref name="DH" />

During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|infiltration]] team formed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dursa Conegan]] met up with two of its Rebel contacts, [[Cooper Dray]] and [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Amber Comark]] in this cantina. The group was lead there by Lady Comark's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-B4]].<ref name="DH" />
